title: Demo ?payment=success / ?extended=success guards discard the accumulated eff, killing the detail+leaderboard fetches
evidence:
+                Ok(#(_, "success")) if updated_model.demo_mode -> #(
+                  updated_model,
+                  modem.replace(route_to_path(route), None, None),
+                )
detail: Both demo guard arms return only modem.replace, dropping `eff` which already carries the vacancy-detail and leaderboard demo fetches. The non-demo arm batches eff back in. A demo URL with ?payment=success or ?extended=success leaves vacancy_detail/leaderboard stuck on Loading.
recommended_fix: Return effect.batch([eff, modem.replace(...)]) in both demo guard arms, matching the `_ -> #(updated_model, eff)` fallback.

title: enter_demo clobbers a real session's auth and csrf_token with no stash or restore path
evidence:
+          auth: Success(landlord),
+          csrf_token: "demo-csrf-token",
+          demo_mode: True,
+          demo_store: Some(store),
detail: enter_demo unconditionally overwrites auth and csrf_token. A logged-in landlord entering /demo loses the real csrf token from the model; the exit path only calls model.clear_demo_state (demo store fields), so the original token is unrecoverable and subsequent writes 403.
recommended_fix: Stash prior auth/csrf before entering demo and restore on exit, or block demo entry for authenticated sessions (redirect to /dashboard).

title: enter_demo bypasses handle_browser_change and skips its focus-trap uninstall and polling cancellation
evidence:
+          unlock_consent_modal_open: None,
+          unlock_consent_checked: False,
+          unlock_consent_submitting: False,
+          extension_consent_modal_open: None,
+          extension_consent_checked: False,
+          extension_consent_submitting: False,
detail: enter_demo nils the consent-modal fields but never emits policy_reaccept_modal_focus.uninstall(), the exact leak handle_browser_change's comment warns about. It also skips clearing payment_polling/payment_poll_count and bumping scoring_generation, so a real payment poll keeps firing into demo mode.
recommended_fix: Have the Demo-entry arm route through handle_browser_change (or extract a shared reset) so focus-trap uninstall, polling cancellation, and scoring-generation bump apply on demo entry.

title: Demo Comparison boot reads comparison ids from the real session's localStorage, ungated for empty
evidence:
+    routes.Comparison(vid) -> [
+      demo_api.fetch_comparison(
+        store,
+        vid,
+        load_comparison_ids(),
+        ApiReturnedComparisonDetails,
+      ),
+    ]
detail: load_comparison_ids() hydrates ids saved during real landlord usage, so a demo comparison boot can pass real UUIDs (or an empty list) to the demo store. handle_browser_change's Comparison arm explicitly skips the fetch on []; this path fires unconditionally.
recommended_fix: Gate on non-empty ids like handle_browser_change, and use demo-scoped comparison ids rather than the shared localStorage slot.

title: enter_demo seed failure sets route Landing without changing the URL or surfacing feedback
evidence:
+    Error(_) -> #(
+      Model(..model, route: routes.Landing, demo_mode: False, demo_store: None),
+      effect.none(),
+    )
detail: On seed failure the model says Landing while the browser stays on /demo; no modem.replace and no toast. A refresh re-runs the failing boot, and the user sees the landing page under a /demo URL with no explanation.
recommended_fix: Pair the fallback with modem.replace("/", None, None) and an error toast per copy conventions.

title: routes.Dashboard arms in enter_demo / demo_entry_effects are unreachable
detail: enter_demo is only called with routes.Demo (BrowserChangedUrl arm) or routes passing is_demo_route, whose Dashboard case is absent (`_ -> False`). The Dashboard branches of the vacancies/dashboard_stats cases and demo_entry_effects can never fire.
recommended_fix: Drop the Dashboard alternatives, or add routes.Dashboard to is_demo_route if dashboard deep-link boot is intended.

title: Demo refcheck path hyphenates the action for the response message; the real path passes it through raw
detail: The comment says the shared toast matcher knows the hyphenated wire form, yet the unchanged real path dispatches ApiReturnedRefcheckAction(call_id, action, result) with the raw action. Either the real path mismatches the matcher or the demo mapping diverges from it.
recommended_fix: Normalize the action name in one place (the ApiReturnedRefcheckAction construction) so demo and real paths emit identical wire names.

title: demo_store_of docstring duplicates its first line
evidence:
+/// The store for the current demo session (invariant: Some while demo_mode).
+/// The demo store for the client.gleam demo branches — delegates to
detail: Two consecutive doc lines both open with 'The demo store...', reading as an editing leftover. Harmless but sloppy in a heavily commented file.
recommended_fix: Merge the two sentences into one docstring.
